purpose: Teach: セッティング/余剰/履行/教委/当人/民放/窃盗/終値

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本社のセッティングをご自分でなさったぞ
lines.en: Your father set up the headquarters himself.
lines.style: Quiet reflection, eyes distant. Measured pace. The voice of someone recalling a decision that mattered. Slight emphasis on 'himself' — admiration held in check.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは余剰金を社員に還元された
lines.en: Yes. He returned the surplus funds to the staff.
lines.style: Steady, direct response. Respectful but not deferential. A son confirming his father's choices with clear understanding. Pace even, grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、約束の履行をなにより重んじた
lines.en: Your father valued keeping his promises above all else.
lines.style: Soft, almost to himself. The voice of someone who learned this lesson. Trailing slightly — letting the weight of it settle. Wistful but not sentimental.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは地元教委とも良好な関係でした
lines.en: Yes. He maintained good relations with the local education board.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Speaking as if mentally filing away another piece of the larger picture. Gentle, reflective.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、お客様当人へお詫び訪問をされた
lines.en: Your father visited customers personally to apologize.
lines.style: Soft wonder in the voice. The pace slightly slower — emphasizing the personal cost of such visits. Admiration edged with gentle sorrow. Trailing off slightly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは民放のCMにも出演された
lines.en: Yes. He even appeared in commercials for a private broadcaster.
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Light surprise in the tone — not cynical, just noting the breadth of his father's reach. Composed, measured delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、窃盗を許さない厳しさがあった
lines.en: Your father had a strict refusal to tolerate theft.
lines.style: Quiet firmness beneath the surface. The words carry weight without harshness. A principle stated with respect and clarity. Slight emphasis on 'strict'.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは終値の動向に敏感だった
lines.en: Yes. He was attuned to every shift in market trends.
lines.style: Final reflection, grounded and clear. The voice of someone closing a meditation. Composed, with the quiet confidence of a man who understood his father deeply. Calm closure.
